release_line_gate.activation_requirement: This change centralizes existing acceptance wrappers and diagnostics only. It does not redesign or weaken milestone success criteria; product/runtime activation remains behind the existing Nagi 0.1 sequence and M30 release boundary.

do_not_try: Do not convert SKIP, BLOCKED, FAIL, or filtered NOT RUN cases into PASS.
Do not weaken the M17 first-web-pixel checksum or guest acceptance marker.
Do not change M18 or other milestone state because an acceptance case is unimplemented or not selected.
Do not merge this integration branch directly to main.

next_action: Inspect root run 36233551349 for Windows M0 acceptance and Ubuntu host completion. Inspect the target artifact only if both hosts pass. Keep CI acceptance PARTIAL until the Windows wrapper and integrated workflow are verified; preserve M17 checksum/marker criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A single registry maps acceptance IDs to milestone, subsystem, host/target scope, wrapper, timeout, and test name.
Runner options filter by milestone/subsystem/scope and report all other cases as NOT RUN.
Wrappers execute with a bounded timeout and process-tree cleanup; failures retain logs and distinguish environment, dependency, compile, link, test, timeout, artifact, and command stages.
JSON reports include all selected and filtered case states, and regression comparison marks only prior-PASS cases that are selected and no longer PASS.
CI retains machine-readable reports, case logs, and existing M17 diagnostic artifacts after failed steps.
M17 continues to invoke the unchanged strict first-web-pixel acceptance wrapper and requires its real pixel evidence.
deferred: Public integrated GitHub Actions result for the acceptance-runner commit.
Unselected target acceptance cases remain NOT RUN; no milestone PASS is inferred from the two M0 host cases.
M17 stays BLOCKED until its guest pixel checksum and acceptance marker are produced by the unmodified underlying wrapper.
